Class WorkoutFileLoader

java.lang.Object
WorkoutFileLoader
public class WorkoutFileLoader extends Object
WorkoutFileLoader.java Reads workouts from a plain text file. Each line holds one workout with 6 comma separated values in this order: id,exerciseName,durationMinutes,bodyWeightLbs,metValue,completed Example line: 1,Running 6 mph,30,180,9.8,true Blank lines are ignored. Lines that are not valid are skipped and counted so one bad line never stops the whole file from loading. Bad file paths (blank, missing, a folder, unreadable) never crash the program. They set an error message the menu can show instead.

  • Method Details

    • readLines

      public List<String> readLines(String filePath)
      Reads every line of a text file. If anything goes wrong, an empty list is returned and getLastError() explains the problem.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the path the user typed (blank or quoted paths are handled)
      Returns:
      the lines of the file, or an empty list on a problem

    • parseLine

      public Workout parseLine(String line)
      Turns one line of text into a Workout. Every value is checked by the WorkoutValidator.
      Parameters:
      line - one line from the file
      Returns:
      the Workout, or null if the line is not valid

    • loadWorkouts

      public List<Workout> loadWorkouts(String filePath)
      Loads every valid workout from a file. Bad lines are skipped and counted. If the file itself could not be read, the list is empty and getLastError() has the reason.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the text file
      Returns:
      the valid workouts found in the file
